description: This file implements the MockPersistentReportingStore class and its nested Command class, including methods for managing reporting endpoints and groups, command verification, and loading simulation, within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: MockPersistentReportingStore
classes.description: A mock class simulating persistent storage for reporting endpoints and groups, used for testing.

classes.name: MockPersistentReportingStore::Command
classes.description: A class representing various command types for the mock persistent store, including constructors, comparison operators, and output streaming.

methods.name: LoadReportingClients
methods.description: Simulates loading reporting clients with a callback.

methods.name: AddReportingEndpoint
methods.description: Adds a reporting endpoint to the command list.

methods.name: AddReportingEndpointGroup
methods.description: Adds a reporting endpoint group to the command list.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupAccessTime
methods.description: Updates access time for a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the current command list, updating endpoint counts.

methods.name: SetPrestoredClients
methods.description: Sets pre-stored clients and groups for testing.

methods.name: FinishLoading
methods.description: Completes the loading process, invoking callbacks with stored data.

methods.name: VerifyCommands
methods.description: Verifies if the command list matches expected commands.

methods.name: CountCommands
methods.description: Counts the number of commands of a specific type.

methods.name: GetAllCommands
methods.description: Returns the list of all commands.
